# Minnie Andrews & Phillips

- [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) — Mentor of — [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a tearful goodbye near the spring after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Devastated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, though [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) remains forced to keep her distance. Channeling her emotions into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional after Mr. Phillips's farewell speech and eager about the arrival of Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. However, during the tea party, Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice a strange taste in Anne's cake.
>
